title: Mạng xã hội nào được nhiều người dùng nhất tại Việt Nam?
publisher: Ministry of Information and Communications of Vietnam (MIC)
methodology: MIC news report of an ABEI 2024 activity-review meeting. It explicitly labels the game-employment total an ABEI estimate; no sample frame, establishment list, reference date, or calculation method is published.
assessment: PRIMARY / ACCEPT. Direct government publication of the only located national game-industry employment level: approximately 4,100 workers in 2024, up 31% year on year. Scope is game industry, not precisely defined; preserve estimate and scope caveat.
access_status: Visited via web index; full text retrieved
next_step: Use as source of record. Seek the underlying ABEI meeting report or statistical release if a formal definition or historical levels are required.

title: Phổ biến Nghị định số 147/2024/NĐ-CP về quản lý, cung cấp, sử dụng dịch vụ Internet và thông tin trên mạng
publisher: Official Online Game Information Portal, Authority of Broadcasting and Electronic Information
methodology: 2026 republication of material from the 2024 electronic-information review meeting; repeats the ABEI estimate without a methodological annex.
assessment: PRIMARY CORROBORATION / DO NOT DUPLICATE. Repeats approximately 4,100 workers and 31% growth. Later publication, so retain the MIC 2024 page as the preferred dated record.
access_status: Visited via web index; full text retrieved
next_step: Use only if the MIC page becomes unavailable; it does not improve definition or add a distinct data point.

title: Vietnam's gaming industry reaching high score in entertainment sector
methodology: News coverage attributing sector employment and revenue estimates to the Ministry; no original survey method presented.
assessment: SECONDARY CORROBORATION / DO NOT USE AS PRIMARY. Reports 4,100 workers and 31% growth, consistent with MIC. Useful for cross-checking attribution only.
access_status: Visited via web index; article excerpt retrieved
next_step: No further action unless the MIC original disappears.

title: Report on labour force survey 2023
methodology: National sample Labour Force Survey covering labour-market participation of residents aged 15+; produces national, regional and provincial labour indicators.
assessment: PRIMARY BACKGROUND / EXCLUDED. Authoritative total-employment survey but the located publication does not supply a game-industry cross-tab. It cannot validate or replace the ABEI sector estimate.
access_status: Visited via web index; full page summary retrieved
next_step: Search NSO microdata/classification tables only if an industry-code series that cleanly maps to game development/publishing is released.

title: VNG Annual Report 2024 - Game
methodology: Company annual-report narrative; reports 1,200 employees alongside game-business metrics but does not provide a country-only game payroll definition.
assessment: COMPANY CONTEXT / EXCLUDED. A single-company figure that may include non-game functions and international locations; not a national employment observation.
access_status: Visited via web index; full page excerpt retrieved
next_step: Do not aggregate company headcounts into a national series without a defined universe and de-duplication.
